subject: general
question:
Six friends Amit, Ben, Ram, Mukul, Manjot and Ajay are living on six different floors of the same building but not necessarily in the same order.. The lowermost floor of the building is numbered 1, the floor above it is numbered 2, and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 6. No two friends live on the same floor. Ajay lives on floor number 3. Amit lives above ben who doesn't live at the bottom. Manjot lives at an odd numbered floor above Ajay. Ram lives below Amit and Ben. Ram does not live on a prime numbered floor. Mukul lives above Ram and below Ben.

On which floor number does Mukul live?
